endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.exists_duplicateCoordinates_comparison
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p q n : ℕ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {ξ : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p} {δ : ℝ},
  RectangleCLT.BoundedIndependentHypotheses μ ξ δ →
    ∀ (r : Fin q → Fin p),
      Function.Surjective r →
        ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ),
          A * A.transpose = RectangleCLT.covariance μ (RectangleCLT.sumVector ξ) →
            ∃ B,
              B * B.transpose =
                  RectangleCLT.covariance μ
                    (RectangleCLT.sumVector fun i ω => RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.duplicateCoordinates r (ξ i ω)) ∧
                RectangleCLT.gaussianLaw B =
                    MeasureTheory.Measure.map (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.duplicateCoordinates r)
                      (RectangleCLT.gaussianLaw A) ∧
                  RectangleCLT.Companion.rectangleDistance μ
                        (RectangleCLT.sumVector fun i ω =>
                          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.duplicateCoordinates r (ξ i ω))
                        B =
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.rectangleDistance μ (RectangleCLT.sumVector ξ) A ∧
                    RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianMaximumMean B = RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianMaximumMean A

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.exists_coordinatePadding_zero_gap_comparison
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p n : ℕ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {ξ : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p} {δ : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p),
  RectangleCLT.BoundedIndependentHypotheses μ ξ δ →
    (∀ (j : Fin p), RectangleCLT.covariance μ (RectangleCLT.sumVector ξ) j j = 1) →
      ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ),
        A * A.transpose = RectangleCLT.covariance μ (RectangleCLT.sumVector ξ) →
          ∃ B,
            B * B.transpose =
                RectangleCLT.covariance μ
                  (RectangleCLT.sumVector fun i ω =>
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.duplicateCoordinates
                      (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.coordinatePaddingMap hp) (ξ i ω)) ∧
              (∀ (j : Fin (p + 1)), (B * B.transpose) j j = 1) ∧
                RectangleCLT.pairGap (B * B.transpose) = 0 ∧
                  RectangleCLT.Companion.rectangleDistance μ
                        (RectangleCLT.sumVector fun i ω =>
                          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.duplicateCoordinates
                            (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.coordinatePaddingMap hp) (ξ i ω))
                        B =
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.rectangleDistance μ (RectangleCLT.sumVector ξ) A ∧
                    RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianMaximumMean B = RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianMaximumMean A
